name: Vinhedo (Brazil)
description: White field with bars forming an off-centred cross — red towards the hoist, three narrow black bars towards the top and bottom, green towards the fly — the intersection void and bearing the outline of a vine leaf.
history: Vinhedo is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil.

features.role: off-centred cross of red, black and green bars with a void intersection
three narrow bars towards the top and bottom
green bar towards the fly and the outline of a vine leaf
